data.name: Headless Rider Horror!
data.description: rumors of the rider’s return has surface…
data.successDescription: “Don’t worry, we got your back!” Hear here the familiar voices of your squad catching up to you. Now you can maybe take on this rider

objectives.description: Distressing reports are flooding in by near by small villages of a headless rider terrorizing the citizens alongside of….zombies??? Head to the last known location of this “headless rider” and see what you can find out.
HELP!!!!!

nextObjectiveId.text: You look around and see a young girl running towards you.

objectives.description: The girl's fear has taken over her, and her screams cannot form words anymore. But you see it now, and the reports are right. A headless rider is chasing, and gaining on the girl. A gourd lit with, what you guess is a candle, where the head of the rider should be.

A bone chilling laugh escapes from the headless rider that disorients you and brings you to your knees. You see the girl fall, guessing unconscious, as she doesn’t seem to have the shinobi training you do.

Another laugh escapes from the gourd's mouth, but you’re not sure how. The rider and the girl are just a couple dozen yards away. You can see the rider and the mount more clearly. The mount is skeletal and sinuous, while the rider looks like a rotting corpse with a big orange gourd placed firmly where its head should be. It seems to be carrying a harvesting scythe in its hand.

The girl seems to be recovering from being unconscious just long enough to lean up. You can tell she isn’t aware of the rider just behind her. Once she is sitting up right, something terrible unfolds. A quick flash of the moonlight hitting the scythe is all you see before the poor girl's head is severed cleanly from her body. The rider dismounts, picks her head up and places it in a burlap sack that seems to be dripping a crimson color. Under the pale glow of the orange harvest moon, it is difficult to tell.

A third and final laugh comes from the rider, and you feel the weightlessness of sleep falling over you. Fearing your demise you drop a smoke bomb, to try and move away from the rider to regroup and re-orientate yourself. But when the smoke clears, the rider is gone. Only thing left is the hoof prints of where the steed once befouled the ground.

Going on guard to make sure you are not surprised, you slowly make your way over to the girl's body. Once you are right next to her, the sun begins to peek over the horizon and dispel this seemingly even aura that clings to the air.

You recognize the girl's clothing as belonging to one of the nearby villages. You pull out a sheet you use while camping and on missions to wrap the poor girl’s body in. From there you take her back to her village to be put to rest properly.

You arrive at the village shortly after the sun fully arises . It seems to be mostly untouched. Warding paper placed at every gate. You call out to see if you can get someone’s attention, still holding the poor girl's body.

nextObjectiveId.text: “Hello? Is anyone here? I need some help.”

objectives.description: Some people start to peek out their windows and once they realize it is day, then slowly come from their homes. A Middle aged man approaches you. “Hello Master Shinobi. I am not sure how we can help. Our village is in dire need as of right now.

nextObjectiveId.text: You explain the situation, about the request from ANBU HQ, and of the girl’s body you have.

objectives.description: Overhearing the conversation a couple runs towards the body you placed on the ground while explaining the situation. They pull the sheet back and they immediately start to cry. You have just found the parents of this girl.

nextObjectiveId.text: The middle aged man starts to talk to you.

objectives.description: The man, who introduces himself as the head of the village, explains the story of the headless rider. After recounting the horrific tale, the village leader asks you are able to help find what is needed to break the curse of the rider and lay him to rest. He explains two things are needed to lay the rider to rest. His skull, that was washed away many years ago in the river, and to destroy the item the rider’s soul is bound to.

nextObjectiveId.text: I will do my best for the sake of Seichi.

objectives.description: The head of the village tells you the location of the village that was destroyed many years ago. He suggests you start there, find the river, and see if anything can be uncovered.

It takes the entire day to get to the village while making sure you are not exhausted to start the investigation. Arriving just after the sun had set, you can see the destruction inflicted upon this village. You start to hear shuffling coming from all around you. You narrowly dodge an attack from….a zombie?!
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: You defend yourself against the attack but see that the entire village is full of the undead. You quickly decide you will not be able to do anything here tonight.  However, it looks like you’ll need to fight your way back out of the village.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: Fighting seems pointless. After dropping the bodies, they stand back up just a few moments later. “Oh great, another wave of them,” you mutter to yourself.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: The undead drag you down by sheer numbers. You break free and fall back out of the ruined village to catch your breath.

Finally you clear the gate of the village, and notice the zombies can’t leave past the gate or they crumble to ash. Well that’s a relief. You then remember the head of the village saying to find the river. So you make your way towards it. Finding the river, your body nearly gives out from exhaustion and going for almost 2 days now. So you decide to rest and take the search up in a few hours.
Your body needed more rest than you thought. It is sunset when you wake up. And lucky for you, nothing attacked while you were sleeping.
Time to start the search. If the skull can even be found.
“Searching along a river at night is not the best idea,” you remark to yourself. “At least I have a full moon to provide some light. Better get looking.”
“Nothing here,” you think  as you continue to look for any sort of skull shaped object. “Hmmm.. maybe it could be a bit farther down.”
“AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!” You hear and recognize that laugh! The headless rider has just materialized out of nowhere is a charging at you!
“Don’t worry, we got your back!” Hear here the familiar voices of your squad catching up to you. Now you can maybe take on this rider

nextObjectiveId.text: Stand with your squad and face the rider

objectives.description: The rider lowers his scythe and spurs the skeletal mount straight at you. The gourd's candle flares. There is no running this time.
objectives.failDescription: The rider's laugh drops you to your knees once more.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw

objectives.description: You come to on the riverbank, ears still ringing. Your squad pulls you up. The rider is circling back.
The scythe falls from the rider's grip and he wheels his mount into the river mist, his laugh breaking apart on the wind. The curse still holds, but tonight the Headless Rider ran from you.
